source='''def transform(grid):
    """Keep foreground pixels where the aligned mask is nonzero; recolor to 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A uniform separator divides source and mask. Prefer the axis on which
    # there is a full separator line/column.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] not in (0,):
            if h == 2 * r + 1:
                n = r
                return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[n+1+i][j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and grid[0][c] not in (0,):
            if w == 2 * c + 1:
                n = c
                return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[i][n+1+j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(n)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No centered separator found")
'''
path=base/'task-f655b4df.py'; path.write_text(source)
print(path)
